channels.name: roundabout_lane_occupancy
channels.method: original map lane topology and frame-joined subject body occupancy
channels.time_window: all 600 original Native frames from approach through exit
channels.reference_frame: original CARLA map and Native frame
channels.uncertainty: physical lane geometry and body projection require original review

channels.name: entry_exit_intent
channels.method: source-backed requested exit plus actual entry, ring sweep and exit heading
channels.reference_frame: original CARLA map and Native frame
channels.uncertainty: intention and exit classification require independent review

channels.name: ego_pose
channels.method: original Native subject transform, velocity and body extent
channels.reference_frame: original CARLA world and Native frame

context_inputs.name: context_roundabout_topology
context_inputs.method: original map ring lane and entry/exit links

limitations: Synthetic fixtures establish software behavior only; original Native motion and pixels unverified.
Lane choice and intended exit are measured separately from any legal verdict.
